pretreatments.description: Shredding operation (I-PT) - mechanical pretreatment using a low-speed knife mill to reduce particle size, eliminating larger particles >20mm
Shredding and mixing operation (II-PT) - combination of shredding and mixing using water addition at 10:1 Water content/Total Solids ratio, favors extraction of organic compounds into liquid phase
Shredding, mixing, and blending operation (III-PT) - sequence of shredding, mixing, and blending (like wet grinders) to alter lignocellulosic structure and create homogeneous liquid slurry
Hammer mill - mobile hammer mill (Noremat Valormax BA915D) on-farm full-scale treatment (M3) for cattle manure
Hammer mill - fixed hammer mill (on-line) on-farm full-scale treatment (M4) for cattle manure
Chain mill - X-Chopper chain mill (Xergi) on-farm full-scale treatment (M4) for silage and cattle manure mixture (SM)
